Resolution criteria:
- "Washington Nationals": Wins if the Washington Nationals have the higher run total at the end of the official final score of the Nationals vs. Marlins MLB game played on August 21, 2026 (UTC).
- "Miami Marlins": Wins if the Miami Marlins have the higher run total at the end of the official final score of the Nationals vs. Marlins MLB game played on August 21, 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- The official final score is determined after all regulation innings (and any extra innings, if applicable) are complete; a game suspended and resumed on a later date resolves based on the final official result whenever it is recorded.
